name: Chuysky Trakt
full: Federal highway R256 “Chuysky Trakt” Novosibirsk — Berdsk — Novoaltaysk (Barnaul) — Biysk — Maima (Gorno-Altaysk) — Seminsky Pass — Ongudai — Chike-Taman — Aktash — Kurai — Kosh-Agach — Tashanta (the border with Mongolia). The mountain section runs from the border of Altai Krai and the Altai Republic (km 428.7) to Tashanta (km 943).
near: Key points: Biysk (km 350–364), Maima/Gorno-Altaysk (km ~440–453), Shebalino (~km 560–570), Ongudai (km 634), Inya (km 703), Aktash (km 788), Kurai (km 822), Kosh-Agach (km 889.7), Tashanta (km 943).
elev: From ~200 m (Biysk/Maima) to 1717 m (Seminsky Pass, km 582–583, Wikivoyage); Chike-Taman 1295 m (amic.ru); on the Chuya steppe and near Tashanta — 1800–2000+ m (atlas.dcsr.ru: “up to 1900–2000 m”); the border at Durbet-Daba Pass (km 964).
short: The main road of Gorno-Altai and one of the most beautiful highways in the world (National Geographic, per vpoxod): ~968 km of pavement from Novosibirsk to the Mongolian border through the Seminsky and Chike-Taman passes, the confluence of the Chuya and Katun, and the Kurai and Chuya steppes.
desc: The Chuysky Trakt (R256, until 2018 M-52) is a historic route from Biysk to Mongolia along which merchant caravans traveled from the 18th–19th centuries; the motor road was built in 1914–1935 and opened on 01.01.1935 (vpoxod, atlas.dcsr.ru). Today it is a federal highway about 968 km long: a flat section Novosibirsk — Biysk (~350 km) and a mountain section of ~600 km from Biysk to the Mongolian border. Kilometer markers (vtourisme): Biysk 350.3; Srostki 384.9 (Shukshin museum); the Altai Republic border 428.7; Maima/the junction to Gorno-Altaysk ~453; Seminsky Pass 582.4 (1717 m, a stele for the 200th anniversary of Altai joining Russia); Ongudai 634; Chike-Taman 662.9 (1295 m, a serpentine road from 1984); Inya ~703 (suspension bridge); the confluence of the Chuya and Katun 712.4; Kalbak-Tash 723; the monument to Kolka Snegiryov 744; Chibit 783; Aktash 788; the fork to Ulagan 790.7; Geyser Lake ~797; Kurai 822; Kyzyl-Tash 830; the turn to Chagan-Uzun/Kyzyl-Chin 865; Kosh-Agach 889.7; Tashanta 943 (international road checkpoint); Durbet-Daba Pass and the border — 964. The surface is asphalt throughout. The road is open year-round, but in winter closures are possible because of snow and rockfalls (on 19.01.2024 a rockfall at km 764 closed traffic Yodro — Aktash, km 737–790). In 2026 repairs are under way: km 455–472 (Souzga — Cheremshanka — Manzherok) and km 479–495 (Izvestkovy — Ust-Muny — Barangol); km 439–444 and 560–570 have been repaired (Tolk 06.10.2026); the reconstruction of km 454–475 into four lanes (18 km: 14.4 km of new road bypassing Souzga, Cheremshanka and Manzherok + 3.6 km of reconstruction, two interchanges, a pedestrian overpass) started on 10.08.2026 (amic.ru), with completion by the end of 2028 (amic) / the second half of 2029 (promrazvedka, 19.36 billion ₽, TSM LLC).
guide: The trakt is not a road “to a destination” but the journey itself: allow at least 2 days from Gorno-Altaysk to Kosh-Agach, otherwise you will fly past all the best parts. Stop at Seminsky (that is where real Altai begins), at the Chike-Taman viewpoint and at the confluence of the Chuya and Katun — the turquoise Katun and the muddy gray Chuya flow side by side without mixing. At km 744 find the monument to Kolka Snegiryov — the driver from the song “There Is a Road Along the Chuysky Trakt”. After Aktash services thin out — fill up at every opportunity and don't speed: there are cows, horses and rockfalls on the road. Buy pies in Srostki — it's a ritual for everyone heading to Altai.
see: Srostki (Shukshin museum, Mount Piket); Seminsky Pass (1717 m, stele); Chike-Taman Pass (viewpoint, serpentine road); Inya (suspension bridge, stelae); the confluence of the Chuya and Katun (km 712, near Inya; a viewpoint with a gazebo, a cafe, the Chuy-Oozy nature and recreation park — seven.travel); the Kalbak-Tash petroglyphs (km 723; entry 250–300 ₽, excursion 300 ₽, children free, ~9:00–19:00 — 2GIS 4.5/167, 2026); the monument to Kolka Snegiryov (km 744); Bely Bom; Aktash and the Red Gates (the turn to Ulagan); Geyser Lake (~km 797); the Kurai steppe with a view of the North Chuya Range and the Kurai Pass; Kyzyl-Chin (“Mars”, the turn at km 865); the Chuya steppe and Kosh-Agach; Tashanta (petroglyphs, the border).
skip: You are flying to Gorno-Altaysk for Lake Teletskoye or Chemal and are not ready to spend 2+ days behind the wheel — the northern part Novosibirsk — Biysk is boring and can be replaced by a train/plane.
diff: Easy for a driver — paved road, passes without extreme gradients; allow for livestock on the road, rockfall sections and winter conditions.
when: June — September (better late August — September: fewer cars, “golden autumn”); in winter it is passable, but closures are possible, especially of the passes and the Yodro — Aktash section.
hours: The road — around the clock; the Tashanta border checkpoint — 09:00–18:00, closed on Sundays and holidays (Rosgranstroy); closed 10–15.07.2026 (Naadam, alta.ru).
daytime: In the daytime — the passes and viewpoints in good light; morning — less traffic on the Maima — Manzherok section (repairs and weekend traffic jams); avoid driving at night beyond Aktash (livestock, rocks).
how: Start: Novosibirsk (km 0) — by car ~4.5–5 h to Biysk, or train 306N Novosibirsk — Biysk (~9 h 25 min, from 1,025 ₽, tutu.ru 2026), buses Novosibirsk — Gorno-Altaysk (4,026–6,300 ₽, ros-bilet 2026); Barnaul — the junction onto the trakt is near Novoaltaysk (km 217); Gorno-Altaysk airport (GRV) is near Maima, 2 km from the trakt (not checked).
needcar: Yes — a car (own/rented), marshrutka (minibus) or a tour. Any regular car is fine for the main road.
self: Yes — this is the most accessible way to see Gorno-Altai. For Russian citizens no permit is needed up to and including Kosh-Agach; Tashanta is a border zone (passport; a permit for foreigners).
roadtype: Paved throughout; mountain serpentines at Seminsky and Chike-Taman; repair sections with reversible traffic (km 455–472, 479–495 in 2026); reconstruction Maima — Manzherok until 2029 (detours).
traveltime: Novosibirsk — Biysk ~350 km (4.5–5 h); Biysk — Gorno-Altaysk ~100 km (1.5 h); Gorno-Altaysk — Aktash ~5 h (marshrutka); Gorno-Altaysk — Kosh-Agach ~450–500 km, 7–8 h; Novosibirsk — Kosh-Agach with a transfer 15–17 h (ros-bilet). A comfortable road trip — 6–10 days (sport-marafon).
stay: Campsites 300–400 ₽/tent (sport-marafon); tourist bases near Aktash 500–2,500 ₽/day (Wikivoyage, outdated); hotels in Aktash from ~4,600 ₽ (101hotels 2026); Kosh-Agach: Rasul from 4,200 ₽ (101hotels 2026), bases from 3,700 ₽ (tropki 2026). It is convenient to plan overnight stops in Ongudai/Inya, Aktash and Kosh-Agach.
net: There is signal along the main road, but it drops out in mountain sections (sport-marafon); specific gaps by operator were not found.
entry: Travel is free (no toll sections found); the tourist tax applies only in Gorno-Altaysk; individual sights by the road (Geyser Lake, Kalbak-Tash and others) are paid at different rates.
transfer: Marshrutka Gorno-Altaysk — Kosh-Agach ≈4,772–7,977 ₽ (2026, sources differ); a tour/transfer in a Land Cruiser — on request.
bring: A full tank after Aktash, a spare wheel, a first-aid kit, cash (not all villages have card terminals — not checked), water and a snack, warm clothes (it is cold on the Chuya steppe and passes even in summer), offline maps.
warn: 2026 repairs: km 455–472 and 479–495 (Souzga — Barangol), reconstruction near Maima/Manzherok until 2029 — traffic jams. Rockfalls: on 19.01.2024 a lane at km 764 was destroyed and traffic Yodro — Aktash was closed (RG). Livestock on the road, especially at night. In winter — snow and ice on the passes. Kosh-Agach District is a border zone (Tashanta and others). The Tashanta border checkpoint is closed on Sundays and holidays. Ticks in season (in the Altai Republic by 25.08.2026 — 3,600 reports).
food: “Srostki pies” (Srostki, pies from 130 ₽, lunch ~500 ₽); “Arzhan-Suu” (km 478, shashlik, plov — after Shukshin's film); “Traktir Nika” (km 292, 24/7, pelmeni) and “Prival” (km 214) — on the flat section (Altapress 05.06.2026); “Na Obochine” (Ongudai, km 656, buuzy, lagman); “Traktir” (Aktash); “Sailyugem” (Kurai, Altai cuisine); “U Katuni” (Inegen) — altaihelicopters.com; in Aktash — “Oasis” (2GIS 4.8/935), “Karavan” (4.4/486).
reviews: No ratings were found for the road as a sight. Seminsky Pass is on TripAdvisor. Fuel stations: Lukoil in Souzga (km 455) 4.9/290, Gazpromneft in Maima 4.9/502, Rosneft Ust-Sema/Shebalino 4.7–4.8 (2GIS 2026). Pluses — views, asphalt quality; minuses — repairs, traffic jams near Maima, slow trucks.

p.sum: The Chuysky Trakt is a paved road ~968 km long from Novosibirsk to Mongolia; the mountain section begins beyond Biysk (km 350) and the Altai Republic border (km 428.7). From Gorno-Altaysk to Kosh-Agach it is ~7–8 h of pure driving, but plan 2–3 days with stops. In 2026 — repairs near Maima/Manzherok and Barangol.

p.permits: Not needed up to Kosh-Agach; Tashanta and the border area are a border zone (passport; a Federal Security Service permit for foreigners). To enter Mongolia — an international passport.
p.access: Suitable for everyone, including children, older people and dogs — paved road and viewpoints by the road.
